reuse.why: Calls the existing shared getExpectedScheduleAmount that forecast, schedules/app and shared/schedules already use, passing the raw _amount.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the one-line field delegates entirely to the shared helper.

placement.why: The field is added in scheduleModel.toExternal in api-models.ts, where the API's external schedule shape is built.

scope.why: Only the API type and its mapper change.

maintainability.why: Minimal and clear; the output-only field is added as optional to the shared APIScheduleEntity type that fromExternal also accepts, a small type looseness.
